typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		loadDate as timestamp,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DT as timestamp,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TAG_CAGE_NBR as string,
		TRADE_DT as date,
		BRANCH_CSTCY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		CURRENCY_CD as string,
		EXTNL_REF_ID as string,
		TAG_DT as date,
		BROKER_CONFIRM_NBR as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as decimal(7,0),
		REMAINING_AMT as decimal(15,2),
		TRANS_CONTROL_ID as string,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD as string,
		ORIGIN_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCT_CSTCY_CD as string,
		RR_CD as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourceReconControlCage	source(output(
		EFFECTIVEDATE as decimal(38,0),
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		TRANSACTION_DT as timestamp,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		FRST_MNY_AMT as decimal(17,2),
		TAG_TRAN_CD as string,
		CLIENT_USE_TXT as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourcep021ispprod
OLEDBSourceReconControlCage sort(asc(CLIENT_NBR, false),asc(BRANCH_CD, false),asc(ACCOUNT_CD, false),asc(TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD, false),asc(SECURITY_ADP_NBR, false),asc(TAG_CAGE_NBR, false),asc(SETTLEMENT_DT, false)) ~> Sort
OLEDBSourcep021ispprod sort(asc(CLIENT_NBR, false),asc(BRANCH_CD, false),asc(ACCOUNT_CD, false),asc(TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD, false),asc(SECURITY_ADP_NBR, false),asc(TAG_TRAN_CD, false),asc(TRANSACTION_DT, false)) ~> Sort1
Sort,Sort1 join(OLEDBSourceReconControlCage@CLIENT_NBR == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@CLIENT_NBR && OLEDBSourceReconControlCage@BRANCH_CD == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@BRANCH_CD && OLEDBSourceReconControlCage@ACCOUNT_CD == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@ACCOUNT_CD && OLEDBSourceReconControlCage@TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD && OLEDBSourceReconControlCage@SECURITY_ADP_NBR == OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@SECURITY_ADP_NBR && TAG_CAGE_NBR == TAG_TRAN_CD && SETTLEMENT_DT == TRANSACTION_DT,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin select(mapColumn(
		TAG_TRAN_CD = TAG_TRAN_CD,
		TRANSACTION_DT = TRANSACTION_DT,
		FRST_MNY_AMT = FRST_MNY_AMT,
		CLIENT_USE_TXT = CLIENT_USE_TXT,
		EFFDATE = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@EFFDATE,
		EFFECTIVEDATE = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		CLIENT_NBR = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@CLIENT_NBR,
		BRANCH_CD = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@BRANCH_CD,
		ACCOUNT_CD = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@ACCOUNT_CD,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		SETTLEMENT_DT = SETTLEMENT_DT,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD = OLEDBSourcep021ispprod@TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoin01
MergeJoin01 derive(TAG_TRAN_CD = TAG_TRAN_CD,
		TRANSACTION_DT = TRANSACTION_DT,
		FRST_MNY_AMT = FRST_MNY_AMT,
		CLIENT_USE_TXT = CLIENT_USE_TXT,
		EFFDATE = EFFDATE,
		EFFECTIVEDATE = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		CLIENT_NBR = CLIENT_NBR,
		BRANCH_CD = BRANCH_CD,
		ACCOUNT_CD = ACCOUNT_CD,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		SETTLEMENT_DT = SETTLEMENT_DT,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD = TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of EFFDATE} = toDate(EFFDATE, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of TRANSACTION_DT} = TRANSACTION_DT,
		{Copy of CLIENT_USE_TXT} = CLIENT_USE_TXT,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate,
		{Copy of FRST_MNY_AMT} = FRST_MNY_AMT,
		{Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR} = SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		{Copy of TAG_TRAN_CD} = TAG_TRAN_CD,
		{Copy of ACCOUNT_CD} = ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE} = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		{Copy of CLIENT_NBR} = CLIENT_NBR,
		{Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD} = TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		{Copy of BRANCH_CD} = BRANCH_CD) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		TRANSACTION_DT as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		EFFDATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		FRST_MNY_AMT as integer,
		CLIENT_USE_TXT as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TAG_TRAN_CD as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TRANSACTION_DT = {Copy of TRANSACTION_DT},
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR = {Copy of SECURITY_ADP_NBR},
		BRANCH_CD = {Copy of BRANCH_CD},
		EFFDATE = {Copy of EFFDATE},
		CLIENT_NBR = {Copy of CLIENT_NBR},
		ACCOUNT_CD = {Copy of ACCOUNT_CD},
		FRST_MNY_AMT = {Copy of FRST_MNY_AMT},
		CLIENT_USE_TXT = {Copy of CLIENT_USE_TXT},
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD = {Copy of TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD},
		TAG_TRAN_CD = {Copy of TAG_TRAN_CD},
		EFFECTIVEDATE = {Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
